subject.title: Bug: v2026.7.1-2 full profile + llama.cpp MTP server returns 413/400 on tool payload

question: Should OpenClaw support this llama.cpp MTP incompatibility through a targeted provider/model schema-normalization path, or treat the server's parser limitation as an external compatibility constraint documented by a reduced tool profile?
rationale: The evidence supports a real regression candidate, but it does not yet distinguish a stable OpenClaw compatibility contract from a server-version-specific parser limitation; choosing a generic flag or fallback without that boundary would create long-term configuration and compatibility surface.

options.title: Targeted compatibility repair
options.body: After live reproduction, add a narrowly detected schema-normalization path and regression proof for the identified llama.cpp MTP version/model combination.

options.title: Document reduced profile
options.body: Keep generic schemas unchanged and document coding or minimal as the supported tool profile for this server until llama.cpp exposes a compatible parser contract.

options.title: Defer to server contract
options.body: Request upstream llama.cpp reproduction and parser guidance before committing OpenClaw to any compatibility behavior.

recommendation.title: Targeted compatibility repair
recommendation.body: After live reproduction, add a narrowly detected schema-normalization path and regression proof for the identified llama.cpp MTP version/model combination.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the only evidence-backed adjacent contributor found for OpenAI-compatible tool-schema compaction, though ownership confidence remains low because their prior PR was not merged.
